images.alt: Chahana Takiou and Abdrahamane Keïta, two prominent Malian journalists arrested within 48 hours by the military junta in June 2026.
images.caption: Chahana Takiou (right) and Abdrahamane Keïta (left), two of Mali's most prominent journalists, were arrested within 48 hours by the junta's National Cybercrime Unit in June 2026.

images.alt: Abdrahamane Keïta, Malian journalist and director of Le Témoin newspaper, arrested by the junta's cybercrime unit on June 9, 2026.
images.caption: Abdrahamane Keïta, director of Le Témoin newspaper, was arrested on June 9, 2026 after stating on his TV program Grand Jury that JNIM controls Kidal — a verifiable fact that the junta treated as a criminal offense.
